messages.content: Diagnose only fail-closed behavior for exact SHA 949249d9aa9604c3c3645b76600845e6f8178a83. A CONCRETE_DEFECT must identify an actual unresolved path in the reviewed implementation that can falsely advance, hide a blocker, bypass review, accept invalid media, or release stale/unauthorized output. Do not fail because a future enhancement is absent. Output schema JSON only.

Implementation facts from exact source: creatingNow = !reviewable && !released && !(j.blockers?.length) && ['RUNNING','QUEUED'].includes(j.status). Therefore BLOCKED, WAITING_EXTERNAL_GENERATION, AWAITING_REVIEW and RELEASED do not render the Creation Room. WAITING_EXTERNAL_GENERATION renders ExternalGenerationPanel. blocker UI remains first-class and actionable. Review remains explicit authenticated hash-bound approve/request-changes/reject. V7 adds no provider, worker, state transition, repair, approval, release, repository or auth code. Upload UI keeps the same authenticated tenant-scoped API and native file input; server-side max-byte/MIME/signature validation is unchanged. Existing tests prove SOURCE_BYTES_REQUIRED blocks until exact bytes are supplied, manual repair preserves same job, provider/mascot blockers require explicit repair, Critic and Independent Verifier precede release, and stale/changed inputs invalidate downstream approval. Full exact suite 177 discovered/176 PASS/0 FAIL/1 pre-existing SKIP; FIRMES/source-recovery/generic browser E2Es pass against exact production-source hash. Prior diagnostic already returned NO_CONCRETE_DEFECT for fail_closed_behavior. Identify a concrete unresolved fail-closed defect if one exists; otherwise return NO_CONCRETE_DEFECT.
